purpose: Compare fixed-topology refinement, existing finite-thickness insertion, classical zero-thickness needle search, growth-only escape, and joint growth-then-needle on deterministic teaching cases. These synthetic cases do not represent measured coating materials or manufacturing qualification.

reproducibility.execution: serial; no GPU or concurrent candidate evaluation
reproducibility.materials: constant-index, lossless optical data held in memory from this file; do not write to or depend on MaterialLibrary persistence

manufacturing_limits.semantics: The limits are fixed before runs. Methods that cannot enforce a limit during search must report that limitation; every final candidate is audited against all four limits and a violation is never counted as feasible.

solver_and_budget.objective_solver: bounded trust-region reflective (TRF) for local thickness refinement
solver_and_budget.evaluation_definition: One objective evaluation means scoring one complete wavelength-angle-polarization grid for all active objective bands. A structure-method evaluator's shared max_evaluations counter includes both training-grid evaluations and its coarse internal validation-grid evaluations; this makes its 120-call ceiling stricter, so report validation_evaluations separately and do not imply equal search work at equal caps. Fixed TRF and legacy finite-needle expose training/search evaluations separately from their optimizer validation count. When an evaluator returns score and thickness Jacobian together, count that evaluator once in forward_equivalent_evaluations and report its Jacobian work separately rather than double-counting the same combined pass. Count separate finite-difference forward evaluations as additional objective/forward-equivalent work. The dense 0.25 nm benchmark holdout audit is post-run and outside every optimizer budget. If an API exposes only a per-polish cap rather than a run-wide cap, enforce the run-wide limit in the benchmark adapter or mark the run budget-limited and incomparable.
solver_and_budget.normalized_acceptance_note: Algorithm-reported targets_met uses acceptable_normalized_error=0.001. Hard physical target attainment is independently evaluated at the exact bounds in each case; the small solver acceptance allowance does not change or relax the frozen physical target.

grid_and_weight_rules.training_grids: Uniform closed grids with the per-case point count; both endpoints included.
grid_and_weight_rules.training_angles_and_polarizations: Evaluate s and p separately at every listed angle; never average amplitudes. Unpolarized responses are not substituted for the separate s/p records.
grid_and_weight_rules.objective_weights: Equal total weight per target band, then equal weight per listed angle and polarization. Wavelength samples within each band are uniform and equally represented.
grid_and_weight_rules.holdout_grids: Independent uniform 0.25 nm grids, endpoints included; do not use holdout values during search, ranking, or stopping.
grid_and_weight_rules.additional_angle: 45 degrees is a holdout-only stress angle. It is reported separately and is not part of the frozen target-met decision.

cases.name: Broadband antireflection

method_controls.position_sample_fractions: k/18, k=1..17 inside every host layer, plus all N+1 true interfaces; sites ordered by cumulative physical thickness

cases.hard_physical_acceptance: R <= 0.010000 at every holdout wavelength, target angle, and polarization; separately report 45-degree holdout results.

cases.name: Broadband high reflector

method_controls.position_sample_fractions: k/18, k=1..17 inside every host layer, plus all N+1 true interfaces; sites ordered by cumulative physical thickness

cases.hard_physical_acceptance: R >= 0.990000 at every holdout wavelength, target angle, and polarization; separately report 45-degree holdout results.

cases.name: Narrow passband with two rejection bands

method_controls.position_sample_fractions: k/18, k=1..17 inside every host layer, plus all N+1 true interfaces; sites ordered by cumulative physical thickness

cases.hard_physical_acceptance: T >= 0.900000 throughout the passband and R >= 0.950000 throughout both rejection bands at every holdout wavelength, target angle, and polarization; separately report 45-degree holdout results.

methods.description: Refine only thicknesses in the frozen initial topology.
Existing finite-thickness insertion implementation as present at run time; do not reinterpret it as an analytic needle method.

controls.trial_thickness_rule: the existing implementation uses the request minimum, exactly 20 nm, for its one trial

methods.description: Zero-thickness one-sided structural sensitivity search and thickness refinement.
Existing-layer thickness growth escape followed by local refinement, without a subsequent needle stage.
Growth escape, local refinement in the reached topology, and a separately evidenced needle stage.

legacy_finite_needle.continuous_internal_position_sensitivity: not supported; probes finite insertions at the request's finite interface/position trials
legacy_finite_needle.total_physical_thickness_cap: not exposed as a needle-request limit; adapter must reject/audit out-of-cap results and record lack of search-time enforcement
legacy_finite_needle.lossless_constant_material_snapshot: must be verified from the frozen service/request adapter before counting a run; if unavailable, mark blocked rather than persist materials

classical_needle_only.max_added_layers: The current bounded structure request requires exactly one needle-layer allowance; 1 is frozen for these runs.
classical_needle_only.continuous_internal_position_sensitivity: Supported; 17 interior fractions k/18 per host layer plus every real interface. The initial topology plans 38 (AR/HR) or 110 (narrowband) position-material pairs, while candidate_budget=8 permits only partial coverage; report exact probed/unprobed trace and never claim a global no-needle result.
classical_needle_only.candidate_thickness: Nine fixed widths spanning 20..350 nm; total-layer, per-layer, and total-physical-thickness feasibility checked before optical scoring.
classical_needle_only.total_physical_thickness_cap: Supported at search time by max_total_thickness_nm=2800 nm.
classical_needle_only.lossless_constant_material_snapshot: Explicit frozen in-memory snapshot only; no MaterialLibrary persistence.

growth_only.max_added_layers: No needle layer; growth modifies an existing row while preserving the frozen row's lower/upper physical bounds.
growth_only.growth_cycle: Exactly one bounded cycle. Absolute steps 0.5,1,2,5,10 nm unioned with phase fractions 0.25,0.5,1 times lambda_ref/(2*n_candidate); one pass over each permitted existing row, not recursive growth.
growth_only.total_physical_thickness_cap: Supported at search time by max_total_thickness_nm=2800 nm.
growth_only.lossless_constant_material_snapshot: Explicit frozen in-memory snapshot only; no MaterialLibrary persistence.

growth_then_needle.max_added_layers: Exactly one needle-layer allowance, frozen as 1; growth escape is one cycle before the separately traced needle stage.
growth_then_needle.continuous_internal_position_sensitivity: Supported with the same position grid as classical_needle_only; candidate_budget=8 makes planned grids partial in all initial topologies, so coverage and budget stop must be reported.
growth_then_needle.candidate_thickness: Nine fixed widths spanning 20..350 nm; total-layer, per-layer, and total-physical-thickness feasibility checked before optical scoring.
growth_then_needle.growth_cycle: One nonrecursive pass over existing rows with absolute and phase-derived steps. The combined path retains a growth branch selected by smooth SSE even when it is worse than the historical best under the exact lexicographic score, then searches needles in that post-growth topology.
growth_then_needle.total_physical_thickness_cap: Supported at search time by max_total_thickness_nm=2800 nm.
growth_then_needle.lossless_constant_material_snapshot: Explicit frozen in-memory snapshot only; no MaterialLibrary persistence.

independent_optics_check.method: Airy/characteristic-admittance recursion implemented in the benchmark harness, with no calls to the project's optical forward kernel
independent_optics_check.scope: At least the lossless normal-incidence (0 degree) spectrum for the best candidate of every method and case on the corresponding 0.25 nm holdout grid.
independent_optics_check.expected_regime: For lossless stacks R+T=1 to numerical precision; report measured differences and do not hide disagreement by retuning targets.

initial_stack_audit.purpose: Capture a descriptive, unoptimized starting point for each case before the five-method matrix.
reported_metrics: separate 0.25 nm target holdout hard-target attainment

counterexample_diagnostics.purpose: Look for a case where a best interior zero-thickness sensitivity is more downhill than the best interface sensitivity, and for a finite-width sign/rank reversal relative to the zero-thickness smooth-loss derivative.
procedure: Evaluate one complete zero-thickness analytic-Jacobian training-grid probe for every initial-topology position and each candidate material (AR/HR: 38 probes; narrowband: 110 probes).

Among probes with at least one finite width that passes all frozen physical limits, select the most negative smooth-loss derivative in each class (interior and true interface); deterministic tie break is frozen material order L then H, then cumulative position ascending.

For each selected class probe, exact-score the nine frozen finite widths 20, 61.25, 102.5, 143.75, 185, 226.25, 267.5, 308.75, 350 nm only when the proposed persisted design satisfies per-layer min/max, total physical thickness, and layer-count limits before scoring.

A finite-width derivative reversal is present only if the zero-thickness gradient predicts a smooth-loss decrease (gradient < 0) but at least one feasible sampled finite width has smooth loss above the unperturbed baseline; report all widths and actual score changes. A rank reversal of exact lexicographic target score is reported separately.
If the cap or hard feasibility leaves a class/grid incomplete, list scanned/unscanned counts or infeasible widths; do not claim absence of an effect outside observed probes.
counterexample_diagnostics.ranking_or_target_effect: none; these diagnostics do not rank the five methods or change any physical target/acceptance decision
counterexample_diagnostics.zero_thickness_feasibility_note: Zero-thickness rows exist only in derivative probes and are never persistent designs. A split-host sensitivity probe may be evaluated mathematically with the core API, but it is not called manufacturing-feasible; finite-width candidates are scored only after every physical bound passes.

anti_selection_rule: Do not alter initial stacks, target bounds, grids, weights, manufacturing limits, seed, or budgets after viewing results. Record failures, budget stops, unsupported constraints, and non-improving cases as observed.
